verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Muse has an official Mac app (muse-supp-mac-whatsapp-clients) but there is no mention of OS-level keyboard shortcuts or the app having access to what's on the user's screen — Muse's core architecture is described as running in its own remote VM/computer (muse-docs-1), not observing the local desktop. Missing for 10: any documentation of OS-level shortcuts, screen capture/reading, or local screen context integration.
